implementation_evidence: Modular source main at 48257d96ae5c05fcc44f036b461982eb0c7df1ff; Provider controls and live quote validation are implemented and tested. Owner direction allows enabled paid models with the shared 10,000-credits/USD ledger; the previous free-only Chat restriction no longer applies to model selection. REQ-5BEC18A71622.next_action: Verify live provider admission, 429 handling, account-level Durable Object contention and restart persistence; retain paid-model selection under the owner-directed shared-credit policy.
REQ-5BEC18A71622.requirement_text: Provider admission SHALL be coordinated across Worker instances using durable Cloudflare Durable Objects, not process-local memory. For OpenRouter free models, the limiter SHALL be keyed by a one-way hash of the provider account identity returned by `GET /api/v1/key`, so adding another key for the same account cannot multiply its allowance. It SHALL pace requests at no more than the documented 20 starts/minute and read the live daily limit and remaining quota (free accounts may have 50/day; eligible credited accounts may have 1,000/day). Cache the quota briefly, account for this system's starts since the snapshot, enforce global/per-user concurrency, honor `Retry-After` on definite 429 rejection, and fail closed when provider limits cannot be read. Provider credentials SHALL be transient to the rate-control lookup and SHALL NOT be stored in Durable Object state, Queue messages, logs or receipts. Durable Queue consumers SHALL use automatic concurrency scaling (no fixed maximum); the provider-account Durable Object SHALL keep outbound requests within the upstream account limit. Auto/model selection SHALL exclude provider models that are no longer present or that are no longer free; a stale catalog entry SHALL not cause an unbounded or paid fallback. A request whose provider outcome is ambiguous (including a lost response, 408, or 5xx after dispatch) SHALL NOT automatically call the provider again; an expired lease with an unfinished provider attempt SHALL settle as `provider_outcome_unknown`.
REQ-5BEC18A71622.verification_method: Core package: 117 tests across 19 files; Chat package: 29 tests across 3 files; focused Core/Chat typechecks and isolated builds passed; deployment controller: 11 tests passed; local/public smoke passed. REQ-B6FD5A53E627.next_action: Run authenticated job admission plus local Workerd outbox replay, Queue redelivery and duplicate-delivery proof after account UAT is available.
REQ-B6FD5A53E627.requirement_text: Chat LLM requests SHALL be admitted quickly and executed in the background so provider latency does not hold the browser request open and concurrent users are buffered instead of overwhelming an LLM provider. Admission SHALL write the job and its outbox intent atomically to the existing canonical `worker_jobs` and `worker_job_outbox`; it SHALL NOT create a second job ledger. The outbox publisher SHALL deliver a small, versioned job reference to a Cloudflare Queue, and the Queue consumer SHALL claim the canonical job with a lease/fencing token before calling the provider. Queue redelivery, publisher retries and duplicate client submissions SHALL be idempotent.
